observations: Two photos show stacks of bare engines on wooden/metal shelving inside what looks like a used-parts yard or container warehouse.
Top shelf in both photos shows a larger engine block with visible pulley/belt arrangement consistent with a V-type engine.
Bottom shelf in both photos shows smaller engines with black plastic cam covers, consistent with inline configuration.
A yellow tag reading 'No Oil No Filter' and what appears to be an 'LKQ' heading is clipped to one engine, suggesting a US salvage-auction origin tag.
No stamped engine code, VIN tag, or serial plate is legible on any block in either photo.
No transmission unit is visible in either photo despite transmissions being mentioned in the listing.
Floor and shelving are dirty/oily, typical of a tokumbo (used import) engine yard, no engine is shown running or being tested.

identity.kind: used petrol engine assortment (inline and V-type), transmission not shown

claims.evidence: No grading mark, inspection sticker, or condition report visible in either photo; 'first grade' is a seller label, not shown.
Smaller inline engines on bottom shelf could match an inline-4 family, but no engine code or plate reading '2AR' is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
Top-shelf engine shape is consistent with a V6, but no engine code or plate reading '2GR' is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
No transmission unit appears in photo 0 or photo 1; nothing to check pin count or condition against.

claims.claim: Implied working/good condition (by omission, no defect stated)
claims.evidence: No compression test, start-up clip, or oil-pan/timing-cover close-up shown; yard tag suggests drained of oil, so running condition is unproven.

risks.risk: Engine family/model may not match seller's claim (2AR vs 2GR), which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped engine code on the block (usually near the engine mount or cylinder head) or the partial VIN/parts tag.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic used engine, lowest plausible tier for that body style

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition unknown (compression, timing chain/belt wear, oil sludge, cracks).
risks.proof: A start-up video with the engine running and no unusual noise/smoke, plus a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-running / needs-rebuild worst case

risks.risk: Transmission not shown at all; could be missing, mismatched, or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual transmission unit with visible 22-pin connector and casing, ideally the pairing to one of the specific engines.
risks.if_unproven: excluded from price / priced as not included until shown

risks.risk: Mileage and prior accident/flood history unknown, common issue with tokumbo imports.
risks.proof: Odometer photo or import auction sheet/history report tied to this specific unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-history, lowest comparable tier

risks.risk: Multiple engines are shown together; unclear which specific unit corresponds to the one being sold/priced.
risks.proof: A single clear photo of the exact unit for sale, isolated, with its tag visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-value unit visible in the group

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine code/stamp or parts tag identifying 2AR vs 2GR.
Photo or video of the actual transmission unit with the 22-pin connector visible.
Start-up video or compression test clip for the specific engine being sold.
Odometer or auction/history sheet tied to this specific tokumbo unit.
A single, isolated photo of the exact engine (and transmission) being offered, not the whole stack.
response.reason: The engine model that sets the price (2AR vs 2GR) cannot be read from any plate or stamp in the photos, and the transmission central to the listing is not shown at all, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to a specific item.
